title: Nitter and XCancel are dead (again) after X's latest legal actions | TechCrunch
summary: Despite the threat, Nitter said on its GitHub page that “following legal advice, the Nitter project will continue,” and promised more details would come soon. Back in 2024, Nitter’s main instance, Nitter.net, temporarily went offline after X rolled out new API restrictions.
